# looker_user (Data Source)

Looks up a single Looker user by email address. Use `looker_users` instead when you need to list all users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "looker_user" "example" {
  email = "user@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user. Matched case-insensitively.

### Read-Only

- `can_manage_api3_creds` (Boolean) Whether the user can create, view, and delete API keys for their own account. This field is marked as experimental in the Looker API and may not be available on your instance.
- `first_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean)
- `last_name` (String)
